held_out_access_policy: load numeric held-out responses only after frozen fit and source checksums pass

acceptance.tier_policy: a pass is one condition-shift F-I sub-gate only; it cannot award V1 without independent resting-voltage, membrane-time-constant, and adaptation evidence

known_nonblind_information: The paper reports no aggregate intrinsic-excitability change after chronic exposure; cell-level model errors have not been inspected.
claim_boundary: Tests transfer from two solvent-control DL5 training cells to four different chronic-exposure DL5 cells in the same paper; not an independent laboratory, male, DM1/DM4, or complete cellular validation.
